remarks: Beautifully Updated Condo in the Heart of Stamford's Coveted Cove Neighborhood. Step inside this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2 full bath main-level condo, where thoughtful design meets low-maintenance living just minutes from Stamford's scenic shoreline. With minimal-step entry and a layout that lives comfortably, this home has been carefully maintained and tastefully upgraded throughout. The recently renovated bathrooms showcase designer features like glass shower doors, custom shower niche, bench seating, and statement tilework, including striking hexagon tile flooring. The kitchen offers an abundance of cabinetry with crown molding, stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a tile backsplash that ties it all together. Wide plank flooring grounds the main living space, while crown molding, chair rail, and wainscoting add warmth and sophistication to several areas of the home. Enjoy a reserved parking space, additional storage, and all the benefits of living in the Cove-one of Stamford's most desirable coastal communities. Washer / dryer located within the unit for convenience. With nearby beaches, parks, Cove Island, Chelsea Piers, Metro North, I-95, and vibrant downtown just minutes away, the location is truly unbeatable. This is a home that exceeds expectations-offering comfort, quality, and a lifestyle you'll love.
